## Settled findings to verify

- C01 / `kiro:0`: lexical `@Test` matching accepted a class with no executable test. The fix must use per-class Surefire XML execution evidence and reject missing, skipped, failed, and errored testcases. CI and assurance promotion must run the check after a clean test run.
- C02 / `kiro:1`: a run could claim `promoted` without an archived copy. The verifier must enforce the exact CSV schema, allowed statuses and reasons, safe unique paths and IDs, existing archive copies, and SHA-256 artifact coverage.

Both findings were reproduced before the fix and reverse-verified by disabling each new check. Treat them as settled only if the final implementation and tests actually close them.

## Attack surfaces

- Profile activation and default-reactor exclusion; Maven dependency resolution, Java 8 production bytecode, Java 11 test compilation, and JUnit discovery.
- Concrete bypasses of metadata, per-class execution evidence, stale reports, malformed XML, and Surefire class-name matching.
- Assurance v2 finalization, required-gate handling, promotion eligibility, CSV parser edge cases, safe paths, duplicate identities, and SHA-256 coverage.
- Consistency between every workflow MUST/MUST NOT and the actual scripts, POMs, CI job, and agent instructions.
- Context isolation between implementation, isolated test generation, assurance promotion, and independent review.
- The C-0001 public contract and whether its assertions detect opposite behavior.
- The verifier test class rename and its sixteen exact verification-integrity exceptions: confirm every original test remains and no unrelated exception is introduced.
- Incoming verification-integrity behavior and protected-path reporting on the rebased development line.

## Required assurance classification

The earlier Kiro review rejected `assurance: SKIPPED`; this change now requires a full contract-first-assurance run. Do not reclassify it as skip-eligible.

The first Codex review timed out twice and a later Codex attempt hit `max_output_tokens`; none produced findings or a clean baseline. Refactoring review settled R1 as deferred, R2 as reverted for excess growth, R3 as rejected, and R4 as applied. Review the complete final range rather than relying on those results.

summary: The new profile and basic settled checks are present, but the assurance controls still permit unrelated execution evidence and ambiguous or unproven promotion records to produce a passing verification result.

findings.title: Execution evidence is matched only by simple class name
findings.trigger: Leave the tagged io.github.monadrome.parallelinscope.C0001TaskIdContractTest class empty, then have a generated test source outside test_root in another package execute a passing other.C0001TaskIdContractTest. Its normal Surefire testcase is accepted because it has the same simple name.
findings.consequence: The post-clean execution check can pass even though the actual contract class has no executable testcase, reopening the hollow-class bypass.
findings.evidence: scripts/check-contract-tests.py:63-64 records only the simple source class name, and scripts/check-contract-tests.py:30-33 strips the package from each Surefire classname before matching it.
findings.suggestedFix: Derive each contract class's fully qualified name from its package declaration and require testcase@classname to equal that name. Also reject testcase records without a non-empty method name.

findings.title: A promoted row can pass without regression-suite execution evidence
findings.trigger: Create a contract-route run with a valid hashed promotion archive and promoted CSV row, mark the existing contract gates as pass, and leave commands empty. verify_run.py accepts it because the contract and concurrency routes do not require regression-tests.
findings.consequence: An assurance report can claim a candidate was promoted without recording a clean suite test or the per-class execution-evidence check required for promotion.
findings.evidence: The phase requires all three promotion checks in .agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/SKILL.md:363-365, but .agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/adapters/vformation.yaml:53-56 omits regression-tests from contract and concurrency routes. .agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/scripts/verify_run.py:321-342 permits an empty commands list and never conditionally requires those checks after a promoted row.
findings.suggestedFix: Require a passing regression-tests gate whenever promotion-status.csv contains a promoted row, and validate recorded successful metadata, clean-test, and execution-evidence command results before accepting that row.

findings.title: Promotion path aliases bypass uniqueness checks
findings.trigger: Use two promoted rows whose archive paths are promotions/C0001TaskIdContractTest.java and promotions/./C0001TaskIdContractTest.java, with analogous target paths and hashes under both raw artifact keys. Both spellings resolve to the same files but the verifier accepts them as distinct.
findings.consequence: One archive and destination can be represented as multiple promotions, violating the required unique target and archive paths and corrupting promotion traceability.
findings.evidence: scripts/verify_run.py:77-90 constructs Path objects for filesystem access, while scripts/verify_run.py:92-100 stores the unnormalized CSV strings in the duplicate-detection sets. Artifact lookup at scripts/verify_run.py:85 also uses the raw spelling.
findings.suggestedFix: Reject dot components and canonicalize validated repository-relative paths to one POSIX form before artifact lookup and duplicate checks.

findings.title: Promoted rows do not have to identify their candidate origin
findings.trigger: A promoted CSV row with empty candidate_id and source_contract_id, a valid C-0001 contract_id, a safe target, and an existing hashed archive returns no promotion error. Reusing one candidate_id across otherwise distinct promoted rows also passes.
findings.consequence: A passing run can claim a durable promotion without a traceable candidate or frozen-contract origin, making it impossible to audit whether reverse verification and eligibility applied to that test.
findings.evidence: scripts/verify_run.py:66-100 validates status, reason, contract_id, and paths, but never reads candidate_id or source_contract_id. This conflicts with the required candidate recording in .agents/skills/contract-first-assurance/SKILL.md:355-358.
findings.suggestedFix: For promoted rows, require non-empty candidate_id and source_contract_id, reject duplicate promoted candidate IDs, and validate that the candidate ID appears in the sealed candidate-status record.
